LAVA STRIDER CR 3

This insect glides across lava like a water strider across a pond. Its glowing red carapace shimmers with heat while searing-hot venom drips from sickle-like pincers at its jaw.

XP 800
N Small vermin
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 27 (5d8+5)
Fort +5, Ref +3, Will +1
Immune fire, mind-affecting effects
Weaknesses vulnerability to cold and automatically slowed (as the spell slow) for 1 round whenever it takes 6 or more points of cold damage

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +6 (2d4+2 plus flameblood venom)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Attacks flameblood venom, spew lava

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 15, Con 13, Int —, Wis 10, Cha 2
Base Atk +3; CMB +4; CMD 17 (25 vs. trip)
Skills Acrobatics +6, Perception +4, Stealth +6; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics, +4 Perception, +4 Stealth
SQ erratic movement, superheated carapace

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Erratic Movement (Ex)

Lava striders move with an unpredictable, herky-jerky motion, dodging obstacles and threats with ease. They gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC.

Flameblood Venom (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 13; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Con; cure 3 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Spew Lava (Ex)

A lava strider may spew lava as a standard action, once every 1d4 rounds. Lava shoots from the strider’s mouth in a 15’ line and deals 4d6 fire damage to those creatures within the line. A successful Reflex save (DC 13) halves the damage. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Superheated Carapace (Ex)

A lava strider constantly emits waves of superheated air in a 5’ radius of itself. Any creature that starts its turn adjacent to a lava strider must make a successful DC 13 Fortitude save or take 1d6 fire damage. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment volcano
Organization solitary or infestation (4-10)
Treasure half standard (random NPC gear that wasn’t destroyed by environmental lava)

A lava strider’s eggs must be exposed to intense heat to hatch, making lava striders perfect inhabitants of volcanic mountains.

Once hatched, the larval lava striders quickly grow to adulthood within one week.

Thereafter, they live only to eat and breed, spending their entire lives in and around lava. Lava striders prefer a diet of scorched flesh, though the particular type of meat is irrelevant. Lava striders instinctively rush towards any sort of movement to investigate the source’s potential as a meal.
